q.g: The specified UNTAR armor needs to be used while making the Scav kills with an 5.56 UN weapon. You can modify the weapons and bring additional items to what is required. If you lose the initial set of gear, you can purchase all the specified gear from Peacekeeper. You can use any of the following: * Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle * Colt M16A1 5.56x45 assault rifle * Colt M16A2 5.56x45 assault rifle
